content: This medication can be harmful if ingested. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. For less severe cases, contact a poison control center without delay. Residents in the United States can call 1-800-222-1222, while those in Canada can call 1-844-764-7669. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition and should not be used for other purposes. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store this medication at room temperature. Do not dispose of it by flushing it down the toilet or pouring it into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed, following local disposal guidelines. The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the medication is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your individual health needs. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all potential drug interactions. Keep a detailed list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. For formulary information, you may compare the status of this medication with others in the same class by creating a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Note that individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information.
